test_framework: No automated test runner configured; manual lint-only (tsc --noEmit)
verification_instructions: 1. Run lint: source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && npm run lint  2. Run build: source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && npm run build  3. Run migration: source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && export SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN="***" && supabase db push
setup_instructions: source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh - must be run before all npm/node commands. Node v22.23.2, npm 11.4.2 already installed.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. Supabase CLI already linked. Must prefix all commands with 'source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh'.
contribution_requirements: Commit message format: 'feat: ...' Push directly to main.
key_patterns: Server modules export registerXxxRoutes(app, supabase). Security middleware: requireSession(roles[]), durableRateLimit, concurrencyGate, requireSameOrigin. Frontend uses useAppContext() for language, bilingual t(en, mr) helper. Motion/react for animations, glass-card-static CSS class. Supabase service-role client created in app.ts and passed to all route modules.
directory_structure: Root: server/ (Express route modules), src/ (React SPA with components, contexts), supabase/migrations/ (SQL migrations), dist/ (build output), public/ (static assets)
